text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, we visited a cafe to appear on a show
we had been invited to during the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Zero customers.
Dead silence, I say...!"

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for everything!
We truly appreciate you agreeing to appear on the show.

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
"Just as in the materials I sent, this will be an interview format!
To thoroughly dive deep into Kawakami Princess-san's charms, I've rented out this entire venue!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
R-Reserved entirely!? Meaning it's my own private cafe!?
How utterly princess-like...!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. We carefully selected your conversation partner, after all.
I'm sure it'll make for a wonderful recording!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
And so, "Everyone's Umamusume Race!" has begun!
Today's opponent is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Kawakami Princess here!
Standing in the center works for you, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course you can't!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because the star of today is none other than me,
Magical Girl Sweepy!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're my interview partner?!
Oh my, really?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Sweep Tosho... She's the Umamusume
who won the Queen Elizabeth II Cup
that I watched alongside Kawakami Princess before.)

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text: Now, now, how about you're both the stars of the show?♪

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Now then, today we have advice from Shuka Sho Umamusume
Sweep Tosho-san for Kawakami Princess-san...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ehh.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why should I have to give advice
to some cocky punk princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nuwa! Calling a princess a... thug?!
Who on earth taught you such language?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aha, that's got nothing to do with you, Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, even if you cry and beg,
I won't give you a single piece of advice♪"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ! ...Hmm, aha~

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's quite enough, Sweep-san.
I now understand why you've been acting so mean.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, Sweep-san, you don't actually
have any helpful advice to offer, do you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is simply because I am too strong.
They can do nothing but criticize out of spite...
I can understand that frustration myself.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...!?
Are you making fun of me!?

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... both of you, calm down?!
U-Um... let's, let's move on to the next corner...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was watching the situation alongside the TV producer from behind the cameras, but—

text_block_list.name: Passing Madam A
text_block_list.text:
"What in the world is with those girls...?
What an utterly vulgar squabble."

text_block_list.name: Passing Madam B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that magical girl and the fierce horse girl.
You know, the fierce one from the Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passersby cast puzzled glances as the heated exchange
between the two echoes outside the shop.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. If there's any problematic part on your end,
please let me know and I'll cut it.
By the way, it's totally OK on our side!”

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to capture them chatting naturally.
Those two are just so strong and charming, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
Even without dressing up fancy, just being themselves,
there are Umamusume who shine brightly on the Tiara route.
...I wanted to show the viewers that that's perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm embarrassed to admit it...
My best friend's daughter is an Umamusume, and the Tiara route has always been my dream. But just the other day—

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
"I gave up on that. After all, I'm not lovely.
Even my elementary school friends told me
a tiara doesn't suit me..." she said.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
...I don't understand what it means to be "unlike yourself."
Does that word really have enough power to rob someone of the courage to pursue their dreams?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ugh, that really ticks me off! You, enter this year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, I was planning to enter even without you telling me!
Though naturally, I'll be taking 1st place with ee-ea-sy effort.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, there's no way I could lose!
Are you ready to bawl your eyes out on the dirt!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"That's what YOU should do!
On the day of the race, I'm gonna hit you with some mega magic!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two are heating up as usual.
In the end, she couldn't get any advice
for the Shuka Sho from Sweep Tosho, but...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Our showdown will be at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
choice_data_list: (They both look so full of life...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The sight of the girls filled with motivation
was reportedly met with high praise when the program aired.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, while checking a recorded TV program...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I have fan letters for
Kawakami Princess from the front office.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for going out of your way!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I actually had some documents
I wanted to hand over to you anyway.
I'll give them all to you at once.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "The showdown will be at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this...
could it be that TV show from the other day?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You both were so full of energy and wonderful.
Fufu, maybe that's why you receive so many fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After reviewing the materials for the Shuka Sho,
I open a paper bag containing fan letters for Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While checking through the letters to make sure none addressed to the other girls got mixed in...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unusually, there were several fan letters addressed to both of us. I picked up one of them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Opening the envelope to check its contents, what I found inside was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The worst."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RATTLE-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer!
My, what has gotten you in such a fluster?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, keeping secrets from me?
Oh my, oh my, could it possibly be~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Geez, nothing escapes this princess's eyes!
Though I'll pretend I didn't see anything for now♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think you'd prepare a surprise gift
for when I win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup♪
As expected of my Trainer, how stylish of you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...In a reflex, I hid the paper bag filled with fan letters from Kawakami Princess's sight.
choice_data_list: （……I wonder if the others have the same thing inside?）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel bad for her, but
I want to check the contents before handing over the rest.
I tuck the paper bag deep inside the cardboard box."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is a professional athlete, yes,
but she is also still immature, sensitive, and growing—
a child whom adults must protect.
